import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (val : Int) (is_end : Bool) (left mid right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ b _ _ _ => b

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ l _ _ => l

def mid (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ m _ => m

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let l := match t.left with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let r := match t.right with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let m := match t.mid with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => t.val :: s) | none => ∅
  let current := if t.is_end then {[t.val]} else ∅
  l ∪ r ∪ m ∪ current
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.left.isNone ∧ t.mid.isNone ∧ t.right.isNone

def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  (0 ≤ t.val ∧ t.val < 256) ∧
  -- Check Left
  (match t.left with 
   | some l => 
       well_formed l ∧ 
       !is_empty_node l ∧ -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny pruning
       (∀ s ∈ view l, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c < t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Right
  (match t.right with 
   | some r => 
       well_formed r ∧ 
       !is_empty_node r ∧ -- CRITICAL
       (∀ s ∈ view r, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c > t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Mid
  (match t.mid with 
   | some m => 
       well_formed m ∧ 
       !is_empty_node m -- CRITICAL
   | none => True)
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
   | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
   | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Match Dafny input constraint
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def optView (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some n => view n
  | none => ∅

def wfOpt (t : Option Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | some n => well_formed n ∧ !is_empty_node n
  | none => True

def headLtOpt (t : Option Node) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ s ∈ optView t, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c < v

def headGtOpt (t : Option Node) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ s ∈ optView t, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c > v

def prune (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  if is_empty_node t then none else some t

def deleteRaw : Option Node → List Int → Option Node
| none, _ => none
| some (Node.mk v b l m r), [] => some (Node.mk v b l m r)
| some (Node.mk v b l m r), c :: cs =>
    if c < v then
      prune (Node.mk v b (deleteRaw l (c :: cs)) m r)
    else if c > v then
      prune (Node.mk v b l m (deleteRaw r (c :: cs)))
    else
      match cs with
      | [] => prune (Node.mk v false l m r)
      | _ :: _ => prune (Node.mk v b l (deleteRaw m cs) r)
termination_by t key => sizeOf t
decreasing_by
  all_goals
    simp_wf
    omega

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t key) : Option Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  deleteRaw t key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Option Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (match result with
   | some res => well_formed res ∧ !is_empty_node res
   | none => True) ∧
  view_opt result = view_opt t \ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma view_opt_eq_optView (t : Option Node) :
    view_opt t = optView t := by
  cases t <;> rfl

lemma view_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v b l m r) =
      optView l ∪ optView r ∪ (optView m).image (fun s => v :: s) ∪
        (if b then {[v]} else ∅) := by
  unfold view optView Node.left Node.right Node.mid Node.val Node.is_end
  cases l <;> cases r <;> cases m <;> simp

lemma view_empty_of_is_empty {t : Node} (h : is_empty_node t) :
    view t = ∅ := by
  cases t with
  | mk v b l m r =>
      cases b <;> cases l <;> cases m <;> cases r
      all_goals
        simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right,
          view_mk, optView] at h ⊢

lemma optView_prune (t : Node) :
    optView (prune t) = view t := by
  unfold prune
  by_cases h : is_empty_node t
  · simp [h, optView, view_empty_of_is_empty h]
  · simp [h, optView]

lemma wfOpt_prune {t : Node} (h : well_formed t) :
    wfOpt (prune t) := by
  unfold prune
  by_cases hempty : is_empty_node t
  · simp [hempty, wfOpt]
  · simp [hempty, wfOpt, h]

lemma nil_not_mem_opt : ∀ t : Option Node, [] ∉ optView t
| none => by
    unfold optView
    simp
| some (Node.mk v b l m r) => by
    intro h
    change [] ∈ view (Node.mk v b l m r) at h
    rw [view_mk] at h
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image] at h
    rcases h with (((hl | hr) | hm) | hc)
    · exact nil_not_mem_opt l hl
    · exact nil_not_mem_opt r hr
    · rcases hm with ⟨s, hs, heq⟩
      cases heq
    · cases b <;> simp at hc

lemma range_of_wf {v : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256 := by
  unfold well_formed Node.val Node.left Node.right Node.mid at h
  exact h.1

lemma wf_left_of_wf {v : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    wfOpt l := by
  unfold well_formed Node.val Node.left Node.right Node.mid at h
  cases l with
  | none =>
      unfold wfOpt
      trivial
  | some n =>
      unfold wfOpt
      exact ⟨h.2.1.1, h.2.1.2.1⟩

lemma wf_right_of_wf {v : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    wfOpt r := by
  unfold well_formed Node.val Node.left Node.right Node.mid at h
  cases r with
  | none =>
      unfold wfOpt
      trivial
  | some n =>
      unfold wfOpt
      exact ⟨h.2.2.1.1, h.2.2.1.2.1⟩

lemma wf_mid_of_wf {v : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    wfOpt m := by
  unfold well_formed Node.val Node.left Node.right Node.mid at h
  cases m with
  | none =>
      unfold wfOpt
      trivial
  | some n =>
      unfold wfOpt
      exact h.2.2.2

lemma headLt_left_of_wf {v : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    headLtOpt l v := by
  unfold well_formed Node.val Node.left Node.right Node.mid at h
  cases l with
  | none =>
      intro s hs
      unfold optView at hs
      simp at hs
  | some n =>
      intro s hs
      exact h.2.1.2.2 s hs

lemma headGt_right_of_wf {v : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    headGtOpt r v := by
  unfold well_formed Node.val Node.left Node.right Node.mid at h
  cases r with
  | none =>
      intro s hs
      unfold optView at hs
      simp at hs
  | some n =>
      intro s hs
      exact h.2.2.1.2.2 s hs

lemma headLt_of_subset_delete {old new : Option Node} {key : List Int} {v : Int}
    (hord : headLtOpt old v)
    (hview : optView new = optView old \ {key}) :
    headLtOpt new v := by
  intro s hs
  have hs' : s ∈ optView old \ {key} := by
    simpa [hview] using hs
  exact hord s hs'.1

lemma headGt_of_subset_delete {old new : Option Node} {key : List Int} {v : Int}
    (hord : headGtOpt old v)
    (hview : optView new = optView old \ {key}) :
    headGtOpt new v := by
  intro s hs
  have hs' : s ∈ optView old \ {key} := by
    simpa [hview] using hs
  exact hord s hs'.1

lemma well_formed_mk_of {v : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (hrange : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256)
    (hlwf : wfOpt l) (hlord : headLtOpt l v)
    (hrwf : wfOpt r) (hrord : headGtOpt r v)
    (hmwf : wfOpt m) :
    well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) := by
  unfold well_formed Node.val Node.left Node.right Node.mid
  refine ⟨hrange, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases l with
    | none => trivial
    | some n =>
        unfold wfOpt at hlwf
        exact ⟨hlwf.1, hlwf.2, hlord⟩
  · cases r with
    | none => trivial
    | some n =>
        unfold wfOpt at hrwf
        exact ⟨hrwf.1, hrwf.2, hrord⟩
  · cases m with
    | none => trivial
    | some n =>
        unfold wfOpt at hmwf
        exact hmwf

lemma union_delete_first {α : Type} {A A' B C D : Set α} {k : α}
    (hA : A' = A \ {k}) (hB : k ∉ B) (hC : k ∉ C) (hD : k ∉ D) :
    A' ∪ B ∪ C ∪ D = (A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ D) \ {k} := by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x = k
  · subst x
    simp [hA, hB, hC, hD]
  · simp [hA, hx]

lemma union_delete_second {α : Type} {A B B' C D : Set α} {k : α}
    (hB : B' = B \ {k}) (hA : k ∉ A) (hC : k ∉ C) (hD : k ∉ D) :
    A ∪ B' ∪ C ∪ D = (A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ D) \ {k} := by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x = k
  · subst x
    simp [hB, hA, hC, hD]
  · simp [hB, hx]

lemma union_delete_third {α : Type} {A B C C' D : Set α} {k : α}
    (hC : C' = C \ {k}) (hA : k ∉ A) (hB : k ∉ B) (hD : k ∉ D) :
    A ∪ B ∪ C' ∪ D = (A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ D) \ {k} := by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x = k
  · subst x
    simp [hC, hA, hB, hD]
  · simp [hC, hx]

lemma union_delete_fourth {α : Type} {A B C D D' : Set α} {k : α}
    (hD : D' = D \ {k}) (hA : k ∉ A) (hB : k ∉ B) (hC : k ∉ C) :
    A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ D' = (A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ D) \ {k} := by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x = k
  · subst x
    simp [hD, hA, hB, hC]
  · simp [hD, hx]

lemma image_cons_diff (v : Int) (S : Set (List Int)) (k : List Int) :
    (S \ {k}).image (fun s => v :: s) =
      (S.image (fun s => v :: s)) \ {v :: k} := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨s, hs.1, rfl⟩, by
      intro h
      injection h with _ htail
      exact hs.2 htail⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, hne⟩
    exact ⟨s, ⟨hs, by
      intro h
      subst h
      exact hne rfl⟩, rfl⟩

theorem deleteRaw_correct :
    ∀ (t : Option Node) (key : List Int),
      delete_precond t key →
        wfOpt (deleteRaw t key) ∧ optView (deleteRaw t key) = optView t \ {key}
| none, key, hpre => by
    constructor
    · simp [deleteRaw.eq_def, wfOpt]
    · simp [deleteRaw.eq_def, optView]
| some (Node.mk v b l m r), [], hpre => by
    constructor
    · simpa [deleteRaw.eq_def, wfOpt] using hpre.1
    · ext s
      constructor
      · intro hs
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [deleteRaw.eq_def, optView] using hs
        · intro hsEq
          subst hsEq
          exact nil_not_mem_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (by
            simpa [deleteRaw.eq_def, optView] using hs)
      · intro hs
        simpa [deleteRaw.eq_def, optView] using hs.1
| some (Node.mk v b l m r), c :: cs, hpre => by
    have hw : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) := hpre.1.1
    have hvalid : is_valid_key (c :: cs) := hpre.2
    by_cases hlt : c < v
    · have hEqDel :
          deleteRaw (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: cs) =
            prune (Node.mk v b (deleteRaw l (c :: cs)) m r) := by
        rw [deleteRaw.eq_def]
        simp [hlt]
      have hlpre : delete_precond l (c :: cs) := by
        constructor
        · exact wf_left_of_wf hw
        · exact hvalid
      have hdel := deleteRaw_correct l (c :: cs) hlpre
      have hnew : well_formed (Node.mk v b (deleteRaw l (c :: cs)) m r) :=
        well_formed_mk_of
          (range_of_wf hw)
          hdel.1
          (headLt_of_subset_delete (headLt_left_of_wf hw) hdel.2)
          (wf_right_of_wf hw)
          (headGt_right_of_wf hw)
          (wf_mid_of_wf hw)
      have hnotR : c :: cs ∉ optView r := by
        intro hr
        have hh := headGt_right_of_wf hw (c :: cs) hr
        simp at hh
        omega
      have hnotM : c :: cs ∉ (optView m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
        rintro ⟨s, hs, heq⟩
        injection heq with hcv _
        omega
      have hnotD : c :: cs ∉ (if b then {[v]} else ∅ : Set (List Int)) := by
        intro hmem
        by_cases hb : b = true
        · have heq : c :: cs = [v] := by simpa [hb] using hmem
          injection heq with hcv _
          omega
        · have : c :: cs ∈ (∅ : Set (List Int)) := by simpa [hb] using hmem
          exact this
      constructor
      · rw [hEqDel]
        exact wfOpt_prune hnew
      · calc
          optView (deleteRaw (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: cs))
              = optView (prune (Node.mk v b (deleteRaw l (c :: cs)) m r)) := by
                  rw [hEqDel]
          _ = view (Node.mk v b (deleteRaw l (c :: cs)) m r) := optView_prune _
          _ = view (Node.mk v b l m r) \ {c :: cs} := by
                  rw [view_mk, view_mk]
                  exact union_delete_first hdel.2 hnotR hnotM hnotD
          _ = optView (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {c :: cs} := by
                  rfl
    · by_cases hgt : c > v
      · have hEqDel :
            deleteRaw (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: cs) =
              prune (Node.mk v b l m (deleteRaw r (c :: cs))) := by
          rw [deleteRaw.eq_def]
          simp [hlt, hgt]
        have hrpre : delete_precond r (c :: cs) := by
          constructor
          · exact wf_right_of_wf hw
          · exact hvalid
        have hdel := deleteRaw_correct r (c :: cs) hrpre
        have hnew : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m (deleteRaw r (c :: cs))) :=
          well_formed_mk_of
            (range_of_wf hw)
            (wf_left_of_wf hw)
            (headLt_left_of_wf hw)
            hdel.1
            (headGt_of_subset_delete (headGt_right_of_wf hw) hdel.2)
            (wf_mid_of_wf hw)
        have hnotL : c :: cs ∉ optView l := by
          intro hl
          have hh := headLt_left_of_wf hw (c :: cs) hl
          simp at hh
          omega
        have hnotM : c :: cs ∉ (optView m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
          rintro ⟨s, hs, heq⟩
          injection heq with hcv _
          omega
        have hnotD : c :: cs ∉ (if b then {[v]} else ∅ : Set (List Int)) := by
          intro hmem
          by_cases hb : b = true
          · have heq : c :: cs = [v] := by simpa [hb] using hmem
            injection heq with hcv _
            omega
          · have : c :: cs ∈ (∅ : Set (List Int)) := by simpa [hb] using hmem
            exact this
        constructor
        · rw [hEqDel]
          exact wfOpt_prune hnew
        · calc
            optView (deleteRaw (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: cs))
                = optView (prune (Node.mk v b l m (deleteRaw r (c :: cs)))) := by
                    rw [hEqDel]
            _ = view (Node.mk v b l m (deleteRaw r (c :: cs))) := optView_prune _
            _ = view (Node.mk v b l m r) \ {c :: cs} := by
                    rw [view_mk, view_mk]
                    exact union_delete_second hdel.2 hnotL hnotM hnotD
            _ = optView (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {c :: cs} := by
                    rfl
      · have hcv : c = v := by omega
        subst c
        cases cs with
        | nil =>
            have hEqDel :
                deleteRaw (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) [v] =
                  prune (Node.mk v false l m r) := by
              rw [deleteRaw.eq_def]
              simp
            have hnew : well_formed (Node.mk v false l m r) :=
              well_formed_mk_of
                (range_of_wf hw)
                (wf_left_of_wf hw)
                (headLt_left_of_wf hw)
                (wf_right_of_wf hw)
                (headGt_right_of_wf hw)
                (wf_mid_of_wf hw)
            have hnotL : [v] ∉ optView l := by
              intro hl
              have hh := headLt_left_of_wf hw [v] hl
              exact (lt_irrefl v hh)
            have hnotR : [v] ∉ optView r := by
              intro hr
              have hh := headGt_right_of_wf hw [v] hr
              exact (lt_irrefl v hh)
            have hnotM : [v] ∉ (optView m).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
              rintro ⟨s, hs, heq⟩
              cases s with
              | nil =>
                  exact nil_not_mem_opt m hs
              | cons a as =>
                  cases heq
            have hD :
                (∅ : Set (List Int)) =
                  (if b then {[v]} else ∅ : Set (List Int)) \ {[v]} := by
              cases b <;> simp
            constructor
            · rw [hEqDel]
              exact wfOpt_prune hnew
            · calc
                optView (deleteRaw (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) [v])
                    = optView (prune (Node.mk v false l m r)) := by
                        rw [hEqDel]
                _ = view (Node.mk v false l m r) := optView_prune _
                _ = view (Node.mk v b l m r) \ {[v]} := by
                        rw [view_mk, view_mk]
                        exact union_delete_fourth hD hnotL hnotR hnotM
                _ = optView (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {[v]} := by
                        rfl
        | cons d ds =>
            have hEqDel :
                deleteRaw (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (v :: d :: ds) =
                  prune (Node.mk v b l (deleteRaw m (d :: ds)) r) := by
              rw [deleteRaw.eq_def]
              simp
            have hvalidTail : is_valid_key (d :: ds) := by
              intro k hk
              exact hvalid k (by simp [hk])
            have hmpre : delete_precond m (d :: ds) := by
              constructor
              · exact wf_mid_of_wf hw
              · exact hvalidTail
            have hdel := deleteRaw_correct m (d :: ds) hmpre
            have hnew : well_formed (Node.mk v b l (deleteRaw m (d :: ds)) r) :=
              well_formed_mk_of
                (range_of_wf hw)
                (wf_left_of_wf hw)
                (headLt_left_of_wf hw)
                (wf_right_of_wf hw)
                (headGt_right_of_wf hw)
                hdel.1
            have hnotL : v :: d :: ds ∉ optView l := by
              intro hl
              have hh := headLt_left_of_wf hw (v :: d :: ds) hl
              exact (lt_irrefl v hh)
            have hnotR : v :: d :: ds ∉ optView r := by
              intro hr
              have hh := headGt_right_of_wf hw (v :: d :: ds) hr
              exact (lt_irrefl v hh)
            have hnotD :
                v :: d :: ds ∉ (if b then {[v]} else ∅ : Set (List Int)) := by
              intro hmem
              by_cases hb : b = true
              · have heq : v :: d :: ds = [v] := by simpa [hb] using hmem
                cases heq
              · have : v :: d :: ds ∈ (∅ : Set (List Int)) := by simpa [hb] using hmem
                exact this
            have hmid :
                (optView (deleteRaw m (d :: ds))).image (fun s => v :: s) =
                  ((optView m).image (fun s => v :: s)) \ {v :: d :: ds} := by
              calc
                (optView (deleteRaw m (d :: ds))).image (fun s => v :: s)
                    = (optView m \ {d :: ds}).image (fun s => v :: s) := by
                        rw [hdel.2]
                _ = ((optView m).image (fun s => v :: s)) \ {v :: d :: ds} := by
                        exact image_cons_diff v (optView m) (d :: ds)
            constructor
            · rw [hEqDel]
              exact wfOpt_prune hnew
            · calc
                optView (deleteRaw (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (v :: d :: ds))
                    = optView (prune (Node.mk v b l (deleteRaw m (d :: ds)) r)) := by
                        rw [hEqDel]
                _ = view (Node.mk v b l (deleteRaw m (d :: ds)) r) := optView_prune _
                _ = view (Node.mk v b l m r) \ {v :: d :: ds} := by
                        rw [view_mk, view_mk]
                        exact union_delete_third hmid hnotL hnotR hnotD
                _ = optView (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) \ {v :: d :: ds} := by
                        rfl
termination_by t key h => sizeOf t
decreasing_by
  all_goals
    simp_wf
    omega

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem delete_postcond_satisfied (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t key) :
    delete_postcond t key (delete t key h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have h := deleteRaw_correct t key h_precond
  constructor
  · simpa [delete, wfOpt] using h.1
  · calc
      view_opt (delete t key h_precond)
          = optView (deleteRaw t key) := by
              simp [delete, view_opt_eq_optView]
      _ = optView t \ {key} := h.2
      _ = view_opt t \ {key} := by
              rw [view_opt_eq_optView]
